```{r}
#| context: setup
#| include: false

library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(tabulapdf)
library(DT)

neuro2_available <- requireNamespace("neuro2", quietly = TRUE)
if (neuro2_available) library(neuro2)

options(shiny.maxRequestSize = 50 * 1024^2)

# Standard column order
standard_col_order <- c(
  "scale", "raw_score", "score", "ci_95", "percentile", "range",
  "test", "test_name", "domain", "subdomain", "narrow",
  "pass", "verbal", "timed", "test_type", "score_type",
  "absort", "description", "result"
)

# Conners-4 scale definitions from lookup table
# Common across all raters (self/parent/teacher)
conners4_scales <- list(
  # Content Scales
  "Inattention/Executive Dysfunction" = list(
    subdomain = "Attention/Executive",
    description = "a scale including items related to having trouble paying attention and sustaining attention, as well as difficulty with other areas of executive functioning such as planning, organizing, and time management"
  ),
  "Hyperactivity" = list(
    subdomain = "Hyperactivity",
    description = "a scale including items about restlessness, difficulty staying seated or sitting still, needing to move around, getting overly excited, and talking too much"
  ),
  "Impulsivity" = list(
    subdomain = "Impulsivity",
    description = "a scale including items about interrupting others, blurting out answers, acting before thinking, and having trouble waiting for one's turn"
  ),
  "Emotional Dysregulation" = list(
    subdomain = "Externalizing",
    description = "a scale including items about overreacting, losing temper, and having trouble calming down"
  ),
  "Depressed Mood" = list(
    subdomain = "Internalizing",
    description = "items related to feeling sad, lacking enjoyment in things that used to be enjoyed, and feeling hopeless about the future"
  ),
  "Anxious Thoughts" = list(
    subdomain = "Internalizing",
    description = "a scale including items about the patient's experience of—or difficulty with—regulating fears or worries, including appearing tense or nervous, and worrying too much about different things"
  ),
  # Impairment Scales
  "Schoolwork" = list(
    subdomain = "Impairment",
    description = "items related to turning in late or incomplete work, losing homework, and not checking their work for mistakes"
  ),
  "Peer Interactions" = list(
    subdomain = "Impairment",
    description = "items related to the youth annoying their peers, not being invited by others to play or go out, and others not wanting to be friends with them"
  ),
  "Family Life" = list(
    subdomain = "Impairment",
    description = "items reflecting family disruptions caused by the youth, such as creating stress and chaos among family members, as well as causing the family to be late for appointments"
  ),
  # DSM Symptom Scales
  "ADHD Inattentive Symptoms" = list(
    subdomain = "Inattention",
    description = "items that are consistent with the DSM-5 Inattentive Presentation of ADHD"
  ),
  "ADHD Hyperactive/Impulsive Symptoms" = list(
    subdomain = "Hyperactive/Impulsive",
    description = "symptoms of hyperactivity and impulsivity consistent with DSM-5"
  ),
  "Total ADHD Symptoms" = list(
    subdomain = "ADHD Combined",
    description = "all items from the Conners 4 DSM ADHD Inattentive and Hyperactive/Impulsive Symptom scales"
  ),
  "Oppositional Defiant Disorder Symptoms" = list(
    subdomain = "Disruptive Behavior",
    description = "items representing the DSM symptoms of Oppositional Defiant Disorder"
  ),
  "Conduct Disorder Symptoms" = list(
    subdomain = "Disruptive Behavior",
    description = "items representing the DSM symptoms of Conduct Disorder"
  ),
  # ADHD Index
  "ADHD Index" = list(
    subdomain = "ADHD Index",
    description = "scale composed of the 12 items that best differentiate youth with ADHD from those in the general population"
  )
)

# Load lookup table
lookup_path <- "~/Dropbox/neuropsych_lookup_table.csv"
if (file.exists(lookup_path)) {
  lookup_table <- read.csv(lookup_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) |>
    dplyr::filter(grepl("conners4", test))
} else {
  lookup_table <- NULL
}
```

## Conners-4 Rating Scale Extractor

Upload a Conners-4 PDF report to extract the score table.

**Test Info:** Domain = ADHD/Executive Function | Score Type = T-Score | Test Type = rating_scale

---

```{r}
#| panel: sidebar

selectInput(
  "rater",
  "Rater Form",
  choices = c(
    "Self-Report" = "conners4_self",
    "Parent Rating" = "conners4_parent",
    "Teacher Rating" = "conners4_teacher"
  ),
  selected = "conners4_self"
)

hr()
fileInput("file", "Upload Conners-4 PDF", accept = ".pdf")
numericInput("pages", "Page to Scan", value = 2, min = 1, max = 20)
selectInput("method", "Extraction Method", choices = c("stream", "lattice"), selected = "stream")
hr()
uiOutput("table_selector_ui")
hr()
actionButton("extract_btn", "Extract Tables", class = "btn-success")
downloadButton("download_csv", "Download CSV", class = "btn-primary")
```

```{r}
#| panel: fill

uiOutput("rater_info_ui")
hr()
verbatimTextOutput("status")
hr()
uiOutput("column_mapping_ui")
hr()
h4("Processed Data")
DTOutput("results_table")
hr()
tags$details(
  tags$summary("Raw Extraction (Debug)"),
  DTOutput("raw_table")
)
```

```{r}
#| context: server

safe_numeric <- function(x) {
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9.-]", "", as.character(x))))
}

# Get test name based on rater selection
get_test_name <- function(rater_code) {
  switch(rater_code,
    "conners4_self" = "Conners-4 Self",
    "conners4_parent" = "Conners-4 Parent",
    "conners4_teacher" = "Conners-4 Teacher",
    "Conners-4"
  )
}

# Get narrow designation based on rater
get_narrow_suffix <- function(rater_code) {
  switch(rater_code,
    "conners4_self" = "(Self)",
    "conners4_parent" = "(Parent)",
    "conners4_teacher" = "(Teacher)",
    ""
  )
}

output$rater_info_ui <- renderUI({
  wellPanel(
    h5(get_test_name(input$rater)),
    tags$small("Domain: ADHD/Executive Function | Score Type: T-Score | Test Type: rating_scale")
  )
})

raw_tables <- eventReactive(input$extract_btn, {
  req(input$file)
  withProgress(message = "Extracting...", {
    tryCatch({
      tabulapdf::extract_tables(
        file = input$file$datapath,
        pages = input$pages,
        method = input$method,
        output = "matrix"
      )
    }, error = function(e) {
      showNotification(paste("Error:", e$message), type = "error")
      NULL
    })
  })
})

output$table_selector_ui <- renderUI({
  req(raw_tables())
  n <- length(raw_tables())
  if (n > 1) {
    selectInput("table_idx", paste("Table (", n, "found)"), choices = seq_len(n), selected = 1)
  }
})

selected_idx <- reactive({
  if (!is.null(input$table_idx)) as.integer(input$table_idx) else 1
})

candidate_df <- reactive({
  req(raw_tables())
  df <- as.data.frame(raw_tables()[[selected_idx()]], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  df[] <- lapply(df, trimws)
  colnames(df) <- paste0("V", seq_len(ncol(df)))
  df
})

output$column_mapping_ui <- renderUI({
  req(candidate_df())
  df <- candidate_df()
  cols <- colnames(df)
  
  make_choices <- function(cols, df) {
    setNames(cols, sapply(cols, function(c) {
      preview <- paste(head(na.omit(df[[c]]), 2), collapse = ", ")
      paste0(c, " (", substr(preview, 1, 25), ")")
    }))
  }
  
  choices <- make_choices(cols, df)
  none <- c("None" = "None")
  
  wellPanel(
    h5("Column Mapping"),
    fluidRow(
      column(3, selectInput("col_scale", "Scale:", choices = choices, selected = cols[1])),
      column(3, selectInput("col_raw", "Raw Score:", choices = c(none, choices), selected = if(length(cols)>=2) cols[2] else "None")),
      column(3, selectInput("col_score", "T-Score:", choices = choices, selected = if(length(cols)>=3) cols[3] else cols[1])),
      column(3, selectInput("col_ci", "95% CI:", choices = c(none, choices), selected = "None"))
    ),
    fluidRow(
      column(3, selectInput("col_percentile", "Percentile:", choices = c(none, choices), selected = "None")),
      column(3, selectInput("col_range", "Guideline/Range:", choices = c(none, choices), selected = "None")),
      column(3, selectInput("col_probability", "Probability:", choices = c(none, choices), selected = "None")),
      column(3)
    )
  )
})

processed_data <- reactive({
  req(candidate_df(), input$col_scale, input$col_score)
  
  df <- candidate_df()
  rater <- input$rater
  narrow_suffix <- get_narrow_suffix(rater)
  
  result <- data.frame(
    scale = trimws(df[[input$col_scale]]),
    score = safe_numeric(df[[input$col_score]]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # Add optional columns
  if (!is.null(input$col_raw) && input$col_raw != "None") result$raw_score <- safe_numeric(df[[input$col_raw]])
  if (!is.null(input$col_ci) && input$col_ci != "None") result$ci_95 <- gsub("–|—", "-", trimws(df[[input$col_ci]]))
  if (!is.null(input$col_percentile) && input$col_percentile != "None") result$percentile <- safe_numeric(df[[input$col_percentile]])
  if (!is.null(input$col_range) && input$col_range != "None") result$range <- trimws(df[[input$col_range]])
  if (!is.null(input$col_probability) && input$col_probability != "None") result$probability <- trimws(df[[input$col_probability]])
  
  # Filter valid rows
  result <- result |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(scale), scale != "", !is.na(score))
  
  # Add test metadata
  result <- result |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      test = rater,
      test_name = get_test_name(rater),
      domain = "ADHD/Executive Function",
      test_type = "rating_scale",
      score_type = "t_score"
    )
  
  # Add scale-specific info from lookup
  result <- result |>
    dplyr::rowwise() |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      subdomain = if (scale %in% names(conners4_scales)) conners4_scales[[scale]]$subdomain else NA_character_,
      narrow = if (scale %in% names(conners4_scales)) paste(conners4_scales[[scale]]$subdomain, narrow_suffix) else NA_character_,
      description = if (scale %in% names(conners4_scales)) conners4_scales[[scale]]$description else NA_character_
    ) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()
  
  # Add empty columns for consistency
  result <- result |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      pass = NA_character_,
      verbal = NA_character_,
      timed = NA_character_,
      absort = NA_character_,
      result = NA_character_
    )
  
  # Try to get absort from lookup table if available
  if (!is.null(lookup_table) && nrow(lookup_table) > 0) {
    absort_lookup <- lookup_table |>
      dplyr::filter(test == rater) |>
      dplyr::select(scale, absort) |>
      dplyr::distinct()
    
    if (nrow(absort_lookup) > 0) {
      result <- result |>
        dplyr::select(-absort) |>
        dplyr::left_join(absort_lookup, by = "scale")
    }
  }
  
  # Apply neuro2 ranges if available
  if (neuro2_available && exists("gpluck_make_score_ranges", where = asNamespace("neuro2"))) {
    result <- neuro2::gpluck_make_score_ranges(result, test_type = "rating_scale")
  }
  
  # Reorder columns
  result |> dplyr::select(any_of(standard_col_order))
})

output$status <- renderText({
  if (is.null(raw_tables())) return("Click 'Extract Tables' after uploading PDF")
  paste0("✓ ", length(raw_tables()), " table(s) | ", nrow(processed_data()), " records")
})

output$raw_table <- renderDT({
  req(candidate_df())
  datatable(candidate_df(), options = list(scrollX = TRUE, pageLength = 5))
})

output$results_table <- renderDT({
  req(processed_data())
  datatable(processed_data(), options = list(scrollX = TRUE, pageLength = 15))
})

output$download_csv <- downloadHandler(
  filename = function() paste0(input$rater, "_", Sys.Date(), ".csv"),
  content = function(file) write.csv(processed_data(), file, row.names = FALSE, na = "")
)
```
